label: LibraryService.renew_membership
answer:

    if member is None:

    self._repos['MemberRepository'].update(member.id, is_active=not member.is_active)

label: LibraryService.borrow_book

            raise errors.InvalidBookCopiesError
        loan = self._repos['LoanRepository'].create(
            book_id=book.id,
            member_id=member.id,
            loan_date=datetime.date.today(),
            due_date=datetime.date.today() + datetime.timedelta(days=14)
